versions.content: The function <Up_TlsGetCurrentTime>() shall provide the current UTC time. It is used to assemble the ClientHello handshake message. The time is provided in big endian format and follows either the GMT Unix time format or can be 0 (See IETF RFC 5246, section 7.4.1.2, gmt_unix_time for details).
